raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was re-delivered at 05:00, duplicating txn_ids from the 02:00 delivery (raw has 5147 rows but only 4814 distinct txn_id, so 333 duplicates, matching half of batch 14's 666 rows). Some re-delivered rows also store txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (1768716039000 = 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC, consistent with the ISO value on the original row), which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast and would double-count gold aggregates if the cast were fixed alone. Deduplicating on txn_id (keeping the earliest ingest) and parsing epoch-ms values in silver_transactions yields the correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, txn_ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '%-%' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) END AS txn_ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1) t;"}}
